One required route

31 stages · progress is not auto-assessed

00 · Start here: how to learn, run, and question the results01 · Mathematical language, proofs, and linear algebra02 · Closeness, metrics, neighborhoods, and topologies03 · Continuity, homeomorphisms, connectedness, and compactness04 · Groups, symmetries, paths, loops, and homotopy05 · Surfaces, simplices, triangulations, and pixel geometry06 · Chains, boundaries, homology, and Betti numbers07 · From data to shape: Rips, Čech, alpha, and filtrations08 · Persistent homology, persistence modules, and reading diagrams09 · Implement persistence, trace the algorithm, and test it independently10 · Stability, diagram distances, noise, and scientific uncertainty11 · Useful representations, Mapper, time windows, and honest machine learning12 · Capstone: reproduce, defend, transfer, and audit the book13 · From topology to smooth manifolds14 · Rotations, rigid transforms, and the camera model15 · Measured stereo, calibration, and uncertainty16 · Attention and VGGT, from pixels to proposed geometry17 · Register, validate, and ask topology the right question18 · Make the pipeline efficient without changing the evidence19 · From geometry to cautious interaction hypotheses20 · Independent spatial capstone and continuing mastery21 · Rates, equations, units and what data can identify22 · Smooth flows, coordinate changes and invertible networks23 · Mechanics, Hamiltonian networks and Lagrangian networks24 · Symplectic integration, energy, phase and long rollouts25 · Constraints, projections, retractions and rank failure26 · Physics-informed learning and inverse problems27 · Conflicting gradients, interfaces, separability and PIKANs28 · Functions to functions: DeepONet, Fourier operators and baselines29 · Differentiable simulation, graph physics and attention constraints30 · An independent world-model study: evidence before adoption
